notes: Room price counts every room in the list, and a new museum starts with 10 (entrance, main hall, atrium and 7 shaped rooms), so the first room you build is priced as the 9th.

fishing.source: src/progression/ (species.js, fishroll.js, config.js); rolled at run time by models/montecarlo.mjs

main.name: Main Island
main.blurb: Home. The museum is here, and so is the best pond.

one.name: Island One
one.blurb: The first island. Its museum is shut, but the harbour still bites.

isle.name: The Far Isle
isle.blurb: Warm water, bright fish. You can see it from the dock.

pirate.name: Skull Isle
pirate.blurb: A jungle maze and a captain’s chest.

wreck.name: The Drowned Reef
wreck.blurb: Sunken crates and a deep blue edge.

heist.name: Thieves’ Rock
heist.blurb: A bare rock in the fog.

north.name: The Frozen North
north.blurb: Ice as far as you can see, and holes in it.

cork.name: Cork
cork.text: Bites sooner, and you get a little longer to react.

feather.name: Feather
feather.text: Light as air. A kinder window.

glow.name: Glow
glow.text: Night fish love it. Earned by catching 3 fish at night.

golden.name: Golden
golden.text: The best bite and the longest window.

quests.text: Clean every crack, stain and cobweb in the entrance
Open the main hall through the double doors
Place 3 decor items with the hammer
Talk to a famous visitor in the main hall
Build a new room through the main hall’s middle arch
Upgrade the Curator’s Office at the ticket desk
Hire a tour guide at the staff board
